messages:
Priya K: quick check — vendor team wants to test an integration in staging that requires unwrapping wrapped keys via our HSM proxy. Who needs to sign off and what minimal logging/handling rules do we force? cc @SecOps @JorgeM

SecOps: approval flow is sec-eng + infra lead + product owner for normal requests. For the HSM unwrapping itself we require: short-lived grant (<=1h), audit logging ON, and a pre-test checklist. No plaintext key material in logs or CI artifacts.

Jorge M: operational guidance: do NOT mount secrets as env vars for this flow. Decrypt in-process or use a KMS proxy sidecar that returns ephemeral creds in-memory only. If you must log anything, use the redact layer. Example annotation we use in staging: 

Emma R: ```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  annotations:
    logging.rewriteRules: |
      - pattern: '(?i)(api_key|token|secret|password)=\\S+'
        replace: '<REDACTED>'
env:
  - name: USE_KMS_PROXY
    value: 'true'
```

Max: who signs off on the actual HSM unwrap session? oncall can approve emergencies, but normal testing needs eng manager + infra + sec to sign the ticket. Add timebox and an explicit list of people who can call the unwrap.

Anna L: also add an HSM audit webhook (send key-usage events to restricted S3) and set retention/TL to 90d for staging tests. If vendor needs access, create a demo grant via ticket system, set TTL=3600s and restrict to specific key handles.

Priya K: thanks — I'll open an INF ticket and include the approvers. Plan for the test: ephemeral grant (1h), no env var mounts, logging redaction enabled, HSM audit export on. Any objections?

Jorge M: +1. Also add this quick CI log scrub in case someone accidentally prints a secret during the test: 

```bash
sed -E "s/((api_key|token|password)=)[^\\s]+/\\1<REDACTED>/g" ci.log > ci_sanitized.log
```

Infra-Bot: automated notice — HSM session audit export scheduled for staging bucket when grant is created. Audit objects will land in s3://redwood-hsm-audit/staging/<timestamp>.

Priya K: ack, opening INF-4523 now and will tag @Emma R, @Max, @SecOps for approval. I'll paste the checklist and the kube annotation + sed scrub in the ticket.

SecOps: quick checklist for ticket: 1) approvers listed 2) TTL <= 1h 3) audit export path set 4) no env var secret mounts 5) log rewrite rules present 6) post-test confirm scrub of CI artifacts. Once ticket has these, we can approve. :white_check_mark:
